description: Roll the tournament back. Without to_change_id: restore exactly how it was before the most recent change (tool call or courtside page entry). With to_change_id (an id from get_audit_log): restore to just before that change — it and every later change are discarded in one step, so a burst of unwanted calls unwinds with a single revert. Preview lists exactly what would be discarded; confirm: true applies. To apply exactly what a preview showed, confirm with to_change_id set to the first id in its discarded list — anything that landed in between (a courtside entry) is then listed as discarded instead of silently changing the target. A follow-up plain undo restores what the previous undo discarded.

confirm.description: Omit or false: return a preview of what would change. True: apply it.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency id — retrying a call with the same id never applies it twice

to_change_id.description: A change id from get_audit_log — restore to just before this change, discarding it and everything after it. Omit to undo only the latest change.

tournament_key.description: The tournament's organiser key (starts with tk_)

name: undo_last_change

discarded.description: Every change this rollback discards, oldest first

preview.description: True when this is a preview — nothing was changed

undone_tool.description: Tool behind the earliest discarded change

title: Undo changes
